Categorial

Description: The Categorial pie chart is a breakdown of grammatical categories in terms of percentage. The diagram is a pie chart representing different categories of existence from existential quantifiers to universality, with percentages shown for each category.

Disjunctive & Conjunctive

The Disjunctive & Conjunctive pie chart is a breakdown of different types of logical operations in percentage terms. The slice of the pie chart represented is, basically, the percentage of use of each logical structure.

Approximate Number Generation

The Approximate Number Generation pie chart is a breakdown of different types of number generation structures from absolute absence to approximate quantities with percentages shown for each category.
